fact: The 2023 profile lists 13 territorial gendarmerie brigades in the judicial grouping (5 in Djibouti, 2 in Balbala with a third being built, 2 in Arta, and one each in Tadjourah, Obock, Ali Sabieh and Dikhil) and four police commissariats in Tadjourah, Obock, Ali-Sabieh and Dikhil; it says a new automated fingerprint file financed by France's DCSD was due in 2022 at the criminal investigation brigade, and names no system for recording complaints or cases (denominator; class: identification).
title: Gendarmerie nationale de Djibouti
